thread:
sam: FYI found uploaded CI artifact in s3://partner-ci-artifacts/2026-03-20/build-5432/env.txt that contains VAULT_TOKEN and a couple of vault ciphertexts. looks like partner's CI is stashing artifacts publicly. tagging sec + infra.
hema: can you paste a redacted sample? need to determine exposure scope.
sam: redacted: "VAULT_TOKEN=s.abcdef...REDACTED" and two lines like "VAULT_CIPHERTEXT=vault:v1:AAAAAA...". object ACL currently is `public-read`.
oliver: immediate containment: 1) make object private 2) revoke the vaulted token if it's a token, 3) rotate any secrets referenced, 4) check KMS decrypt logs. who picks which?
sec-oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0501 opened by hema. Severity: medium-high. Suggested runbook: limit exposure, rotate tokens, KMS audit, postmortem.
hema: i'll lock bucket and remove public ACL now: `aws s3api put-object-acl --bucket partner-ci-artifacts --key 2026-03-20/build-5432/env.txt --acl private` and added a temp deny policy for external principals. also created ticket PT-501 for partner to purge artifact.
oliver: sam can you confirm whether the VAULT_TOKEN is an accessor for an AppRole or a legacy token? run `vault token lookup s.abcdef | jq .` and redact.
sam: looked up accessor: token is a batch (ttl 30d) created by partner's CI role `ci-runner-role`. It had policies: staging-read, staging-kv-write. assume it could read and write staging kv.
hema: rotate plan: (a) revoke token and any siblings: `vault token revoke -mode=orphan s.abcdef` (b) create new least-privileged AppRole for partner with secret_id rotation and short TTL (c) rotate any staging credentials that token could access. oliver take lead on creds rotation.
oliver: taking creds rotation. I'll list secrets touched by `staging-*` prefix and schedule rotation. commands: `vault kv list secret/data/staging/` and then for each `vault kv put secret/data/staging/<svc> value=<new>` using generated passwords. will update k8s secrets with `kubectl -n staging set secret ...` and coordinate canary. ETA 45m.
sam: also found vault-transit-wrapped blobs in the artifact. prefer to rewrap via Vault transit without decrypting. lena: (note: lena not in thread) 
hema: for KMS check: run cloud audit: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.serviceName:kms.googleapis.com AND protoPayload.methodName=Decrypt" --limit 100` to see if any unusual decrypts. also check `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log` and search for client IPs outside partner ranges.
sec-oncall-bot: reminders: place temporary watch on vault audit logs, and add detection rule for VAULT_TOKEN-like patterns in incoming partner artifacts.
oliver: rotated staging DB user + API keys referenced by secrets. updated Vault and pushed new Kubernetes secrets to staging. did canary, no error spike. left old credentials disabled for 24h then will destroy.
hema: KMS status: found decrypts by partner-ci-sa from 2026-03-20 02:14 - matched the artifact upload. no other external decrypts. rotated KMS key version to v2 and updated Vault auto-unseal config to point to new version. scheduled rewrap: `vault transit rewrap -mount=transit staging-keys --batch` ran successfully and returned no plaintext artifacts.
sam: contacted partner ops/legal requesting immediate artifact purge + proof of deletion and that their CI won't upload env files. partner responded they had a bad step in their pipeline; they removed it and retrained team. opened follow-up ticket PRT-122.
oliver: added automation in infra repo to scan newly uploaded partner artifacts for regex patterns like `VAULT_TOKEN=|DB_PASSWORD=|AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=` and quarantine objects matching pattern. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/501
sec-oncall-bot: INC-2026-0501 tasks: revoke token (hema), rotate staging creds (oliver), lock bucket & RBAC tighten (hema), artifact purge confirmation (sam), KMS rekey & rewrap (hema). Postmortem due 72h.
deploy-bot: reminder: ensure Dedicated & Private clusters find secrets at new Vault paths; run config sync job `infra/scripts/sync-secret-paths.sh` after rotation.
hema: audit notes: added log-based alert for Decrypt calls from 3rd-party SA outside 9-5 PST, increased vault audit retention to 120 days, and created runbook step to rotate KMS every 30 days for partner-facing keys.
sam: containment done. closing operational items; keeping INC open for postmortem. thank you all.
